title: Self-Pay Visit Package Terms — Sharing Unused Visits
content:
**Sharing unused visits.** Whether visits on a Self-Pay Visit Package may be transferred to another patient, to whom, and how often, is fixed by the tier.

| Tier | Transfers allowed | Who may receive | Minimum unused visits for a transfer | Transfers out of one package |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | No | none | 0 | 0 |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | No | none | 0 | 0 |
| Core 8-Visit Package | Yes | immediate family | 2 | 1 |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | Yes | immediate family | 2 | 1 |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | No | none | 0 | 0 |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | Yes | household | 4 | 1 |

**Meaning of each column**

- *Transfers allowed* — whether unused visits may be transferred to another patient.
- *Who may receive* — the relationship a recipient must have to the holder: immediate family, household, or none where transfers are not allowed.
- *Minimum unused visits* — the minimum unused visits for a transfer to be allowed; 0 where transfers are not allowed.
- *Transfers out of one package* — the maximum number of transfers out of one package.

**Reading the matrix**

Three tiers permit sharing: the Core 8-Visit and Complete 12-Visit Packages to immediate family with at least 2 unused visits, and the Comprehensive 24-Visit Package to the household with at least 4 unused visits. Each of the three allows 1 transfer out of the package. The Starter 4-Visit, Recovery 6-Visit and Post-Surgical 18-Visit Packages permit no transfer.
